title: lycopodium scariosum var. microphyllum
intro: Lycopodium scariosum var. microphyllum, commonly known as the Dwarf Club Moss, is a small to medium-sized evergreen plant species belonging to the Lycopodiaceae family. Traditionally, the plant has been used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium scariosum var. microphyllum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and soothe nervous system imbalances. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
